dedupe_keys.name: spanish transport and logistics observatory otle data

description: The Observatory of Transport and Logistics in Spain (OTLE) of the Ministry of Transport and Sustainable Mobility publishes statistics and indicators on transport in Spain across road, rail, air and maritime modes. Its sections cover mobility of passengers and freight, socioeconomics of the sector, infrastructure and capital (for example 165,832 km of roads, 15,654 km of railway line, 46 Aena airports and 28 port authorities in 2024), the road vehicle fleet, research spending, safety and accidents in all modes, sustainability and logistics, with annual reports and newer monthly and quarterly datasets. Its database tables combine sources such as the road freight survey, the Spanish Railways Foundation observatory, Aena and the Puertos del Estado yearbook; for example freight tonnage by mode is given by year from 2007 to 2024, updated March 2026. Coverage is national. The tables are free to view and export as CSV, Excel, XML or PDF from the report viewer; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: indicators are national aggregates, and the database viewer showed a configuration error alongside the data. They support demand and modal split inputs to national freight and passenger models and policy evaluation. They complement the Eurostat transport statistics catalogued here.
